en.page_models_description: Manage provider connections and models. Switch this session or choose a default for the next one.
en.page_resources_description: Find your extensions, skills, prompt templates and themes. Manage their configured paths in one place.
en.page_host_description: Configure grok-pi features and terminal behavior. Review your changes before saving.
en.page_settings_description: Tune models, context, connections and tools with guided fields or the full JSON editor.
en.pick_provider: Select a provider to inspect its models and connection settings.
en.no_models: This provider has no matching models.
en.res_extensions_hint: Only entries sourced from settings.json can be removed here. CLI entries are read-only.
en.host_readonly_hint: Read-only: nested TOML tables are intentionally not edited by this page.
en.host_error_banner: config.toml could not be read — editing is disabled: {error}
en.raw_json_hint: Advanced editor · shares the same draft as the form
en.provider_form_hint: Preserves provider fields this form does not manage.
en.model_form_hint: Model-specific values override provider defaults when present.
en.f_apikey: API key or environment variable name
en.banner_models: models.json failed to parse — saving is disabled until the file is fixed: {error}
en.banner_settings: settings.json failed to parse — saving is disabled until the file is fixed: {error}
en.confirm_stop: Stop this temporary web configuration server?
en.fatal_401: Unauthorized. Re-open the URL printed by grok-pi.
en.stopped: Server stopped. Run /pi-config web or /pi-models web in grok-pi to start it again.
en.setting_hide_thinking_desc: Hide reasoning blocks in the normal transcript.
en.setting_skill_commands_desc: Expose installed skills as slash commands.
en.setting_quiet_startup_desc: Reduce startup banners and nonessential notices.
en.setting_collapse_changelog_desc: Keep changelog output compact on startup.
en.err_settings_object: settings.json must contain a JSON object.
en.search_hint: Models, resources and settings · Ctrl / ⌘ K
en.search_empty: No matches. Try a model name, setting key or resource path.
en.search_more: Showing the first 50 matches. Refine your search for more.
en.draft_hint: Changes stay in this page until you save.
en.conflict: Configuration changed outside this page. Discard your draft and refresh before retrying.
en.resolve_draft: Save or discard the Settings draft before this operation.
en.busy: Another operation is still running. Please wait.
en.err_model_exists: Model {id} already exists. Choose a different id.
en.err_nonnegative: {key} must be a finite non-negative number.
en.err_url: Base URL must be an http:// or https:// URL.
en.resource_manage_hint: Manage paths in global settings.json. Discovered and command-line resources remain read-only; removing a path does not delete files.
en.confirm_remove_resource: Remove ‘{path}’ from settings.json? No file will be deleted.
en.settings_scope_hint: Edits apply to the global Pi settings file. Project and command-line overrides can take precedence. Terminal-only preferences may not affect Grok Pager.
en.settings_group_defaults_desc: Choose startup defaults and how queued messages are delivered.
en.settings_group_context_desc: Control when Pi compacts context and what it keeps.
en.settings_group_network_desc: Configure Pi connections. A timeout of 0 disables that timeout.
en.settings_group_tools_desc: Configure commands and image handling used by Pi.
en.host_saved: Host settings saved. Items marked restart require a new grok-pi session.
en.shortcut_hint: Ctrl / ⌘ S to save · Esc to close
en.delete_active: This is the current or default provider/model. Select a replacement before deleting it.
en.api_key_hint: Stored in your local models.json. Prefer an environment variable name such as OPENAI_API_KEY.
en.sync_readonly: Read-only until configuration errors are fixed
en.host_desc_pi_subagents: Enable child sessions and native task views. Takes effect in new sessions.
en.host_desc_pi_subagents_v2: Enable team tools, peer messages and nested agents. Requires Pi subagents.
en.host_desc_pi_workflows: Enable the workflow tool and upstream Rhai workflows in new sessions.
en.host_desc_pi_herdr: Report lifecycle and session state to Herdr. Enable only when using Herdr.
en.host_desc_pi_todo: Enable the built-in todo tool and the native task pane.
en.host_desc_pi_todo_v2: Use the V2 todo runtime with migration from V1. Off uses V1.
en.host_desc_pi_ask_user_question: Enable ask_user_question and the native question view.
en.host_desc_pi_loop: Enable /loop, the scheduler and the tasks pane.
en.host_desc_pi_btw: Enable /btw side questions using Pi complete().
en.host_desc_pi_bash: Use enhanced Bash tools in new sessions.
en.host_desc_pi_eval: Choose the Eval runtime for the next session.
en.host_desc_pi_eval_v2_language: Choose JavaScript, Python or both for Eval V2.
en.host_desc_pi_eval_v2_display_mode: Show nested effects, or the legacy source and result card.
en.host_desc_pi_eval_v2_only: Force Eval V2 and hide other Pi tools; explicit CLI tool flags take precedence.
en.host_desc_pi_eval_mcp: Expose the Eval V2-only session through a secret-key authenticated loopback MCP endpoint. Requires Eval V2 only and restarting grok-pi.
en.host_desc_psm_resume_index: Use a running Pi Session Manager for resume search and previews.
en.host_desc_pi_tree_file_rollback: Track file preimages for file-only rollback from the session tree.
en.host_desc_pi_tree_skip_summary_prompt: Navigate immediately without asking to summarize the branch.
en.host_desc_pi_keep_multi_agent: Keep the previous agent tab when /new starts a session.
en.host_desc_review_file_tree: Use a directory tree in session review instead of a flat list.
en.host_desc_review_include_reads: Include read operations alongside edits and writes.
en.host_desc_pi_ask_user_question_notificat: Send desktop notifications for questions while the app is unfocused.
en.host_desc_pi_cache_graph: Show cache hit statistics and graphs in the context view.
en.host_desc_pi_config_skill: Load the bundled skill that explains grok-pi configuration.
en.host_desc_pi_user_markdown: Render expanded user messages with Markdown.
en.host_desc_pi_at_search_hidden: Include hidden files while still respecting ignore rules.
en.host_desc_show_other_tool_args: Display raw input JSON for generic tool cards.
en.host_desc_session_recap: Enable session recaps; configure a recap model separately.
en.host_desc_progress_bar: Report progress to terminals supporting OSC 9;4.
en.host_desc_recap_model: Use a model identifier supported by your Pi catalog; leave empty for no override.
en.host_desc_recap_model_2: Use a model identifier supported by your Pi catalog; leave empty for no override.
en.host_desc_recap_model_3: Use a model identifier supported by your Pi catalog; leave empty for no override.
en.host_desc_btw_model: Use a model identifier supported by your Pi catalog; leave empty for no override.
en.host_desc_btw_model_2: Use a model identifier supported by your Pi catalog; leave empty for no override.
en.host_desc_btw_model_3: Use a model identifier supported by your Pi catalog; leave empty for no override.

zh.page_models_description: 管理服务商连接与模型，切换本次会话模型，或为新会话设置默认值。
zh.page_resources_description: 查找扩展、技能、提示词模板和主题，统一管理配置路径。
zh.page_host_description: 配置 grok-pi 功能与终端行为，检查修改后统一保存。
zh.page_settings_description: 使用分类表单或完整 JSON 编辑器，调整模型、上下文、连接与工具。
zh.search_providers: 搜索 服务商 或模型

zh.res_readonly_hint: 扫描到的资源仅用于浏览，不在此处修改。

zh.f_apikey: API Key 或环境变量名

zh.banner_settings: settings.json 解析失败——修复文件前已禁用保存：{error}
zh.toast_default_set: 默认模型已设为 {服务商}/{model}。

zh.setting_hide_thinking_desc: 在常规对话中隐藏思考块。
zh.setting_skill_commands_desc: 把已安装 Skills 暴露为斜杠命令。
zh.setting_quiet_startup_desc: 减少启动横幅和非必要提示。
zh.setting_install_telemetry_desc: 允许 Pi 的安装相关遥测。
zh.setting_analytics_desc: 允许 Pi 产品分析统计。
zh.err_settings_object: settings.json 必须是 JSON 对象。
zh.search_hint: 模型、资源与设置 · Ctrl / ⌘ K

zh.conflict: 配置已被其他程序修改。请放弃草稿并刷新后重试。

zh.err_url: 接口地址必须以 http:// 或 https:// 开头。
zh.resource_manage_hint: 管理全局 settings.json 中的路径。自动发现和命令行资源只读；移除路径不会删除文件。
zh.confirm_remove_resource: 从 settings.json 移除「{path}」？不会删除磁盘文件。
zh.settings_scope_hint: 编辑全局 Pi 设置。项目和命令行配置可能覆盖这些值；Pi 终端专用偏好不一定影响 Grok Pager。
zh.settings_group_defaults_desc: 设置启动默认值，以及队列消息的发送方式。
zh.settings_group_context_desc: 控制 Pi 的上下文自动压缩与保留范围。
zh.settings_group_network_desc: 管理 Pi 的连接行为。超时值为 0 时禁用该超时。
zh.settings_group_tools_desc: 设置 Pi 使用的命令与图片处理方式。
zh.host_saved: 主机设置已保存。标注「需要重启」的项目需开启新的 grok-pi 会话。
zh.shortcut_hint: Ctrl / ⌘ S 保存 · Esc 关闭
zh.delete_active: 这是当前或默认服务商/模型，请先选择替代项再删除。
zh.api_key_hint: 保存在本地 models.json 中，建议填写环境变量名，如 OPENAI_API_KEY。
zh.host_desc_pi_subagents: 启用子会话与原生任务视图，对新会话生效。
zh.host_desc_pi_subagents_v2: 启用团队工具、代理间通信和嵌套代理。需要先开启 Pi 子代理。
zh.host_desc_pi_workflows: 启用 workflow 工具与上游 Rhai 工作流，对新会话生效。
zh.host_desc_pi_herdr: 向 Herdr 报告生命周期与会话状态，仅在使用 Herdr 时开启。
zh.host_desc_pi_todo: 启用内置 todo 工具与原生任务面板。
zh.host_desc_pi_todo_v2: 使用 V2 todo 运行时并从 V1 迁移；关闭时使用 V1。
zh.host_desc_pi_ask_user_question: 启用 ask_user_question 工具与原生问答视图。
zh.host_desc_pi_loop: 启用 /loop、调度器与任务面板。
zh.host_desc_pi_goal: 启用 /goal 自主循环与 update_goal 工具。
zh.host_desc_pi_btw: 通过 Pi complete() 启用 /btw 旁路提问。
zh.host_desc_pi_bash: 在新会话中使用增强 Bash 工具。
zh.host_desc_pi_eval: 选择下一次会话的 Eval 运行时。
zh.host_desc_pi_eval_v2_language: 选择 Eval V2 使用 JavaScript、Python 或两者。
zh.host_desc_pi_eval_v2_display_mode: 显示嵌套执行结果，或旧版源码与结果卡片。
zh.host_desc_pi_eval_v2_only: 强制使用 Eval V2 并隐藏其他 Pi 工具；命令行工具参数优先。
zh.host_desc_pi_eval_mcp: 通过含密钥鉴权的本地 MCP 端点开放 Eval V2 会话；需先启用仅使用 Eval V2，并重启 grok-pi。
zh.host_desc_psm_resume_index: 通过正在运行的 Pi Session Manager 搜索和预览可恢复会话。
zh.host_desc_pi_tree_file_rollback: 记录文件修改前状态，在会话树中回滚文件。
zh.host_desc_pi_tree_skip_summary_prompt: 跳转分支时直接导航，不再询问是否生成摘要。
zh.host_label_pi_keep_multi_agent: 新建会话时保留代理标签
zh.host_desc_pi_keep_multi_agent: 执行 /new 时保留先前的代理标签。
zh.host_desc_review_file_tree: 在会话审查中使用目录树显示文件。
zh.host_desc_review_include_reads: 审查中除编辑和写入外，也显示读取操作。
zh.host_desc_pi_ask_user_question_notificat: 应用不在前台时，为提问发送桌面通知。
zh.host_desc_pi_cache_graph: 在上下文视图中显示缓存命中统计和图表。
zh.host_desc_pi_config_skill: 加载用于解释 grok-pi 配置的内置技能。
zh.host_desc_pi_user_markdown: 使用 Markdown 渲染展开的用户消息。
zh.host_desc_pi_at_search_hidden: 搜索包含隐藏文件，同时遵守忽略规则。
zh.host_desc_show_other_tool_args: 在通用工具卡片中显示原始输入 JSON。
zh.host_desc_session_recap: 启用会话回顾，需要单独配置回顾模型。
zh.host_desc_recap_mermaid: 允许会话回顾包含 Mermaid 图表。
zh.host_desc_progress_bar: 向支持 OSC 9;4 的终端报告进度。
zh.host_desc_remote_tui_footer: 显示远程 TUI 页脚。
zh.host_desc_recap_model: 填写 Pi 模型目录支持的模型标识；留空表示不设置覆盖值。
zh.host_desc_recap_model_2: 填写 Pi 模型目录支持的模型标识；留空表示不设置覆盖值。
zh.host_desc_recap_model_3: 填写 Pi 模型目录支持的模型标识；留空表示不设置覆盖值。
zh.host_desc_btw_model: 填写 Pi 模型目录支持的模型标识；留空表示不设置覆盖值。
zh.host_desc_btw_model_2: 填写 Pi 模型目录支持的模型标识；留空表示不设置覆盖值。
zh.host_desc_btw_model_3: 填写 Pi 模型目录支持的模型标识；留空表示不设置覆盖值。
